noConstantExtraction.description: Extract constants out while rewriting expression for evaluation

noCommonSubexpressionElimination.description: Apply common sub expression elimination technique for expression evaluation

noCache.description: Cache intermediate computed results to be used in other parts of the expression

language.description: The language to generate code in.

instrumentation.description: Collect instrumentation information for the evalMetrics call

parallelizeNormalizedReads.description: If set, parallelize the reads to multiple time series headers

fullTSDeclTimeRange.description:
If set, hints the engine to restrict TsDecl metrics to use the full time range for fetching everything rather than incremental.
This may be used for fetching more data to influence the result but will have performance implications on the evaluation

combineTsDeclFetch.description:
If set, hints the engine to combine the TsDecl fetches into a single fetch.
This may be used for fetching more data to influence the result but will have performance implications on the evaluation (will save cpu and trade memory)
Note: Be careful, while using this option as it could fetch more data than what could fit in memory and cause oom

evalPlanInclude.description:
Include spec for eval plan. It is a set of comma separated values for fields in EvalPlan.
DEFAULT : time and iotime are included by default. For all others, use the following
e.g "expr, rewrittenExpr, srcTypeFetchSpec, hierarchies, simpleMetrics, evalInstrumentation, tsEvalInstrumentation"
Here's what they mean:
expr - Expression provided by the end user (not so interesting)
rewrittenExpr - How the metric engine rewrote the expression to optimize it and remove common sub expressions
srcTypeFetchSpec - Fetch spec generated to evaluate objects at the end of the path (in simple metrics). If you feel data is present, but metric engine returns missing values, be sure to generate the fetch spec using this approach
hierarchies - Objects obtained at the end of the {@link SimpleMetric#path} on the source objects
simpleMetrics - Results of simple metrics in the given expressions (If you are evaluating a simple metric, the result will be the same)
evalInstrumentation, tsEvalInstrumentation - Profiled view of within the metric expression where exactly the time was spent. This is crucial in understanding which sub metric / expression took the most amount of time during evaluation

title: Evaluation time options to be provided to metric evaluation
name: EvalMetricsOptions
